estimator.reported: drift track referenced to min(TIME), which is the epoch seti_drift_search_generic.py de-drifts to (dt = times - times[0]) and therefore the epoch its reported frequency refers to
estimator.r6committed: drift track referenced to median(TIME), which is what visfit_r6.py does and therefore what dispositioned the round-6 candidate list; it is in error by nudot x T_span / 2 and loses a fast-drifting carrier in a fine window entirely
estimator.control_frequencies: moved off every injected tone of the pass, so that they are event-free as they are by construction in the survey, where a window carries at most one carrier
